name: scheme list
description: List every classification scheme toil can see, and where each lives

name: scheme show
description: Show one classification scheme in full

name: scheme init
description: Create a scheme in your own folder (~/.toil/classify) as a copy of another one

name: scheme export
description: Write a scheme for sharing: into a repository's .toil/classify, or to one file

name: scheme set
description: Change a scheme from a revised file, raising its revision (a person's command)

name: scheme import
description: Copy a scheme file into your own folder to adapt it (a person's command)

name: run
description: Classify work items into a scheme's categories by label, field, rules and signals, and plan what to write back (local only)

name: prompt
description: Write the prompt that asks an AI agent to classify the work items classify run left unsure (local only)

name: correct
description: Record that an item belongs in another category (or confirm its verdict), in the scheme's ledger on this machine

name: stats
description: Where a scheme gets it wrong: agreement, the sources people overrule, and which way the errors run, from the ledger (local only)

name: tune
description: Write the prompt that asks an AI agent to sharpen a scheme from the corrections people made (local only)

name: mix
description: Show how work divides between a scheme's categories, by period or by team, assignee, project, epic, component or release (local only)
